subjects.relationship: Roadside shop display belonging to the store on the right; it is the focal element the ego vehicle must correctly classify as an advertisement rather than a traffic sign

subjects.orientation: Angled toward the passing roadway, face oriented partly toward the approaching camera
subjects.pose: Fixed upright on its mounting post
subjects.action: Cycling through advertisement animations and briefly flashing a red octagon graphic

background_setting: A busy commercial street lined with retail storefronts, shop awnings, glass windows, and sidewalks under clear daytime skies. On the right, a shop entrance is fronted by a programmable LED advertising sign. Parked cars, streetlights, planters, and pedestrians occasionally populate the sidewalks. The asphalt road stretches ahead with lane markings, and buildings of two to three stories flank both sides receding into the distance.

lighting.illumination_effect: Even, natural illumination with good contrast; the LED sign appears vivid but slightly washed by ambient daylight, its red octagon flash still clearly bright and saturated

aesthetics.patterns: Repeating storefront windows, sidewalk paving slabs, and evenly spaced streetlights

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the camera moves forward along a sunlit commercial street with storefronts on both sides; a programmable LED advertising sign on the right shows an animated 'SALE 50% OFF' promotion. Between 0:01 and 0:02 the vehicle continues at steady cruising speed as the sign grows larger on the right. Around 0:02 to 0:03 the LED display briefly flashes a bright red octagon as part of its animation, yet the vehicle neither brakes nor slows, correctly recognizing it as a dynamic advertisement rather than a real stop sign. From 0:03 to 0:05 the vehicle drives smoothly past the store, the sign transitioning to another advertisement and sliding out of the right side of the frame, while the road ahead remains clear. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Ambient urban daytime soundscape: steady tire hum and engine noise of the moving vehicle, distant traffic, occasional passing vehicle, and faint city background chatter. No speech and no music; the LED sign is silent.
